title: Chapter 193: Their Helplessness
content:
Chapter 193: Their Helplessness

Since the thousands of noble children in the city should not be counted on, who else can King Han count on!

Relying on the 20,000 to 30,000 soldiers in the city, plus the tens of thousands of men who may be left in the dozen or so cities outside the city, Korea can only recruit 50,000 soldiers after the war. The old, the weak and the disabled.

With such an underdog, can South Korea really survive without a famous general? King Han expressed doubts.

"Oh, that's all, that's all, what else can I be disappointed with now? If I can barely keep the land of South Korea, and if I can keep the incense burning, it is already the blessing of my ancestors. What else can I think about?" Sighed With a sigh of relief, Han Wang shook his head, turned around and went down the city wall.

Looking at the lonely figure of King Han, Ji Wuye also sighed in his heart, even though he is an insatiable person, doing more harm than good to the existence of Han.

However, from the bottom of his heart, he still hopes that South Korea will become stronger, so that as a general of South Korea, he will be able to enjoy more and more power.

Shaking his head, Ji Wuye didn't want to think about it.

"Soldiers, the city is alive, the city is dead, if you persist for a few more days, reinforcements will come soon!" Turning his head, mobilizing his deep internal strength, Ji Wuye said loudly to the surrounding soldiers.

The tragic siege battle began again, and the soldiers of the Qin army rushed up like a tide again, and the defenders on the top of the city once again cheered up their spirits and concentrated on coping with the upcoming desperate struggle.

Within a few meters of the top of the city, it became the focus of contention for nearly 200,000 troops inside and outside the city.

...

The Qin army's camp, the commander of the Qin army at the moment, had just betrayed South Korea and led several cities in the south of South Korea to seek refuge with Qin. Teng, who had just arrived in Qin, was awarded the post of internal history, in charge of the defense of the Guanzhong defenders.

Now he is appointed as the general who went to South Korea, leading the 200,000 Qin army to attack South Korea.

"General, the soldiers of our army have been exhausted after half a month of hard work, and the number of the army has been reduced by more than half. It is really unsustainable!" A deputy general beside Nei Shiten reported to him explain.

"Why doesn't this general understand, it's just that the king's order will be difficult to answer if the city is not conquered, and our country, Qin, will also fall into a passive position!" Nei Shiteng shook his head, and did not directly respond to the deputy general's words.

"But general, if you continue to fight, the last general may cause mutiny. At this time, the soldiers are already exhausted from the war, and they still have complaints in private!" .

"Then the fight will continue. I, Daqin, have left 100,000 corpses under the city of Xinzheng. In order to quickly break through the Korean pass, I also lost tens of thousands of corpses. In total, there are already 200,000 corpses under him. I can't take it down. This city, what do you want this general to give to the king?" Nei Shiteng burst into anger, if he didn't take this Xinzheng city and destroy South Korea, he might wait for his fate as a surrendered general, but there is only a three-foot white silk , or a poisoned drink!

"Yes, general, the last general understands!" Seeing that his commander was already angry, the deputy general didn't dare to say any more, and nodded his head repeatedly.

"Pass down the commander's order and increase the attack force. From now on, the whole army will be divided into several rounds and attack Xinzheng City day and night. When will it be taken? When can we rest." Nei Shiten thought to himself. Thinking about it, his face became ruthless, and he said his decision.

"But general, the intensity of the siege has already aroused complaints from the soldiers below. If it increases again, it may really cause a mutiny!" Hearing his commander's chaos, the lieutenant quickly persuaded him.

"I know it will cause a mutiny, so you take my personal guards and go to the battalions to patrol, don't allow those soldiers to come into contact with them quietly, and supervise them on the battlefield. In this way, you can also ensure stability for a period of time!" Of course Nesten understood , What I did was to force those soldiers to rebel, but for my own future and life, what's the point!

"This, yes, general, the last general will lead his troops there!" The deputy general glanced at Nei Shiteng, hesitant, but was startled by Nei Shiteng's stare, and quickly nodded in response.

Seeing the leaving figure and the thousands of soldiers following him, Nesten nodded, feeling a little relieved.

Now in the camp of the Qin Army, all the soldiers add up to no more than 100,000 of him. So now that he has three or four thousand people every day, these 100,000 people will all die in a month at most.

Of course, it is impossible to fight a war like this. According to Stern's estimate, among the 100,000 people, 50,000 of them will die, which is probably the peak.

The next step is to force those soldiers to go to the battlefield, which will definitely cause a mutiny. Next, I am afraid that as the coach, my life and safety will be a problem.

So since this is the case, these 50,000 people are going to die anyway, so it is better to make a last-ditch effort and send his personal guards to supervise the battle team, forcing 100,000 people to attack the city overnight, day and night.

With a fierce offensive and a more fearless style of play, try to see if you can break through this Xinzheng city before reinforcements from other countries arrive.

"Whether it's life or death, success or failure, it depends on this fight!" Nesten looked at the battlefield in front of him, and the vortex like a meat grinder deeply stirred his heart.

...

At the border of Dongjun, a 200,000 army has arrived there at this moment, overwhelming and continuous.

The sound of millions of horseshoes stepping over caused the entire East County to tremble.

"Your Majesty, Dongjun is ahead. As long as you pass there, you can go straight to the border between Wei and South Korea!" Cao Cao, who was on the expedition with the army, pointed to the small city ahead, and said boldly.

"Yeah, we're here again!" Zhong Yu nodded, sighing a little.

"Your Majesty, shall we take this small city as a supply point?" Cao Cao turned his head and asked Zhong Yu respectfully.

"Forget it, I'm in a hurry now, and I don't have much time to spend on this small town. Xinzheng City is in danger at the moment, and it may be destroyed at any time. If you don't go to the rescue sooner, I'm afraid something will happen!" Shaking his head, Zhong Yu rejected Cao Cao's proposal.

Zhong Yu, who has lived in Xinzheng City for a period of time, is naturally very clear about the combat effectiveness of the South Korean army.

Although this South Korea is known as the Seven Heroes of the Warring States Period, it has long been misnamed. Not only has the land area shrunk greatly, but even their army has become cowardly and incompetent.

Especially for Qin, these South Korean troops have deep fear from the bottom of their hearts. How long can they last in the face of Qin's attack of hundreds of thousands of troops? Zhong Yu didn't know what to do.
